state.seed_assertion: Where necessary, the controller must carry out a review to assess if processing is performed in accordance with the data protection impact assessment at least when there is a change of the risk represented by processing operations.

sentences.1: A risk is a scenario describing an event and its consequences, estimated in terms of severity and likelihood.
sentences.2: A "risk" is a scenario describing an event and its consequences, estimated in terms of severity and likelihood.
sentences.3: As a controller, an organisation will need to assess, decide and document whether a DPIA is necessary for each proposed data processing operation.
sentences.4: As a controller, under the GDPR an organisation will need to assess, decide and document whether a DPIA is necessary for each proposed data processing operation.
sentences.5: Controllers have an overriding obligation in Article 35(1) to assess any proposed processing operation against the requirement to complete DPIAs.
sentences.6: In any event, this list does not affect your overriding obligation in Article 35(1), which is to assess any proposed processing operation against the requirement to complete DPIAs.
sentences.7: In any event, this list is without prejudice to your overriding obligation in Article 35(1), which is to assess any proposed processing operation against the requirement to complete DPIAs.
sentences.8: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.
